name: Afro_Mnist_Dataset
description: A set of synthetic MNIST-style datasets for four orthographies used in Afro-Asiatic and Niger-Congo languages: Ge'ez (Ethiopic), Vai, Osmanya, and N'Ko.
creator: Daniel Jeffrey Wu (Stanford University)*; Andrew Chuming Yang (Stanford University); Vinay Uday Prabhu (UnifyID Inc)
citation: Wu, D. J., Yang, A. C., & Prabhu, V. U. (2020). Afro-MNIST: Synthetic generation of MNIST-style datasets for low-resource languages. arXiv preprint arXiv:2009.13509.
